check_events.outcome: Conditional implication checked explicitly: suppose each element t of T acts on pi by an inner automorphism, so for some a_t in pi one has t(x)=a_t*x*a_t^{-1}. In the abelianization, [a_t*x*a_t^{-1}]=[a_t]+[x]-[a_t]=[x]. Equivalently, t(x)*x^{-1} is the commutator [a_t,x], which dies in pi/[pi,pi], and also dies in the profinite abelianization pi/closure([pi,pi]). Thus the induced T action on pi_ab is trivial. More generally, inner automorphisms act trivially on abelianization, so an outer action has a well-defined induced action there. This verifies the innerness-to-c) implication if that is the premise of the earlier condition b); b) itself was not read because it is outside this packet. No converse, geometric good-reduction criterion, or separate proof of pi_ab=H_1 is claimed.
